'''Melos Tataren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Affiliated with the [[House of Thul]], he sold various items near the [[Thul Palace]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
